newsitem.title: USA: Tower sets San Francisco Int'l flights.
newsitem.headline: Tower sets San Francisco Int'l flights.

text.p: Tower Air Inc said Monday it will start non-stop flights to and from the San Francisco International Airport beginning April 1.
The new flights replace ones from the Oakland Airport, Tower said.

It said that initially it will provide service from New York's John F. Kennedy airport to San Francisco International every Thursday and Sunday, leaving JFK at 4 p.m. and arriving in San Francisco at 6:55 p.m.
Flights will depart San Francisco at 9 p.m., arriving at JFK at 5:25 a.m.

The schedule will be increased to five flights weekly -- Monday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday beginning May 25 and daily after June 20, it said. All departure and arrival times will remain unchanged, it added.
